faq.a: Taqreer is an AI platform that turns your content — text, a file, or an idea — into a fully designed professional presentation in Arabic and English within minutes.
Yes. Taqreer is Arabic-first: correct RTL direction, elegant Arabic fonts, and bidirectional formatting that handles English words and numbers inside Arabic text accurately.

faq.q: How does the credit system work?
faq.a: Each deck uses credits based on its slide count and the model used. You get monthly credits with your plan, plus 400 free credits at signup to try the platform.

faq.q: Can I edit the deck after creating it?
faq.a: Absolutely. The editor lets you edit text, colors, and slides and reorder them, with autosave and checkpoints you can revert to anytime.

faq.q: Can I export the deck to PowerPoint?
faq.a: Yes. You can export your decks as editable PPTX for PowerPoint while preserving the Arabic formatting and text direction.

faq.q: Can I apply my own brand identity?
faq.a: Yes. Upload your logo, colors, and fonts in the brand identity section, and Taqreer applies them automatically so your decks stay on-brand.

faq.q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faq.a: Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime from your account settings, with no long-term commitment.
